_releaseGate: scripts/release-check.js — CI/release tooling must run `npm run release:check` before cutting any release. It exits 1 until every dependency is pinned exact and package-lock.json exists.
_versionPinning: Versions are intentionally unpinned: no manifest ever existed in the repo, and the installed versions live only in the VPS node_modules, which no agent in this track can read right now. BEFORE trusting this manifest: on the VPS, run `npm ls --depth=0`, pin the exact versions here, then run `npm install --package-lock-only` to generate package-lock.json. Until then, `npm run release:check` FAILS by design — release is blocked.
